answer: Dane County Treasurer's Office, 210 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, room 114, Madison; treasurer@danecounty.gov. The office says it cannot give strategic advice or help prepare bids.
quote: The Bid Opening will be held in the Dane County Treasurer's Office (210 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, room 114, Madison, Wisconsin, 53703) ... A walk-through can be scheduled by emailing treasurer@danecounty.gov . ... IMPORTANT: Do not call the Treasurer's Office for sale information. Staff cannot provide strategic advice or assist in bid preparation in any way.
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: Auctions are regularly held in October/November, with one in April/May as needed. Bids are due Tuesday at 1:00pm and opened Wednesday at 10:00am.
quote: Auctions are regularly held in October/November. There may be one in April/May as needed. ... Bid Due date & time: Tuesday at 1:00pm, day before Bid Opening ... Bid Opening date & time: Wednesday at 10:00am, day after Bid Due
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: By sealed bid, using the "Bid Form" button next to each parcel on the Tax Deed Auction page; bids are opened at the Treasurer's Office.
quote: Auctions are conducted through a sealed bid. The Bid Due date is the day before the Bid Opening. ... Bids can be accepted using the "Bid Form" button next to the specific parcel.
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: No registration is required to submit a bid.
quote: No registration required to submit a bid.
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: Yes: an earnest deposit of 10% of the bid, in cash or cashier's check, must be in the sealed envelope with each bid form.
quote: All payments must be in the form of cash or cashiers check. Auction Bidder: Earnest Deposit (10% of the bid) must accompany each completed corresponding bid form within the sealed envelope
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: The balance of the bid must reach the Treasurer's Office within ten days of receiving the award letter, in cash or cashier's check. On default the 10% earnest money is kept and the next bidder is offered the parcel.
quote: Successful Bidder: Balance of bid must be received by the Dane County Treasurer's Office within ten (10) days of receiving the bid award notification letter. IMPORTANT: No payment arrangements, personal or business checks, credit or debit card transactions, ACH, or wire payments. ... The 10% earnest money will be kept by Dane County.
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office

answer: Depending on when the property is bought, the purchaser may have to pay the most recent tax year's taxes and specials to the municipality (for example, December - January purchases, and Madison parcels).
quote: December - January: Successful Purchaser will pay in-full the most recent taxes and any associated specials to the municipality (city/village/town). ... Madison parcels: Successful Purchaser will pay in-full the most recent taxes and any associated specials, interest, and penalty to Madison
source_title: Tax Deed Details | Dane County Treasurer Office
